notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Document read on sec.gov: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001564408-25-000019). Snap files no proxy statement for its 2025 meeting (no DEF 14A appears in its EDGAR filings), and the 10-K itself carries the Item 12 ownership table, as of December 31, 2024. OWNERSHIP: Item 12 gives percentages per class (Spiegel 2.7% of Class A, 26.0% of Class B, 53.4% of Class C) and of total voting power (53.1%), not of all shares, so the economic share is given only as leader.derived (9.97%). His Class A count includes 3,177,844 shares, and his Class B count includes 5,862,410 shares, held in trust where he is trustee. LARGEST HOLDERS left empty on purpose: the 5% holders are stated only as percentages of a class. Entities affiliated with Tencent hold 232,655,030 Class A (16.2% of Class A) and 10,344,970 Class B (45.9% of Class B); FMR LLC holds 209,171,777 Class A (14.6%); The Vanguard Group holds 95,317,701 Class A (6.6%); co-founder Robert Murphy holds 46.4% of voting power. None is a share of all shares, and recomputing is not allowed. The 10-K also warns that Class A holders are exempt from 13D/13G reporting, so large Class A holders may be unknown. BUYBACKS: $311.1 million of Class A repurchased for cash in 2024. PLAN: null. Snap has a 2017 Employee Stock Purchase Plan, but the 10-K says 'No shares of our Class A common stock have been issued or offered under the 2017 ESPP.' GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K says United States revenue was $3.1 billion in 2024.
